learning_outcomes.text: Introduction to three programming paradigms: Concurrent programming, Functional Programming, Logic Programming

assessment_rules: Grades are assigned based on percentages: A 90%, B 80%, C 70%, D 60%, E 50%. The scale of assessment involves regular exercises, a midterm, and an exam, with preliminary/final assessment being 70/30 for midterm and exam. Homeworks, midterm, and exam also contribute to the final grade.
